entries.text: +40% DMG at <60% headcount. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.text: +7% movement speed, unlocks Sprint +15% for 12s. Top pick.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line. Hero pairing: not given in this OP (literal absence, see usage provenance). New Chaos-season unit -- OP authored 2026-06-24 (one day pre-anchor), edited 2026-06-28 (post-anchor); current-season source, not stale. Tierlist letter placement pending ("To place") at capture time, same pattern as White Plume Guards. Playstyle kit: press 1 is a simple charge; press 2 is similar to Liao's Rangers or Kheshig and hits units in a close area; press 3 is a Crowd Control cleanse and charge again -- most likely the unit will charge in with 1, use 2, then use 3 to get out and repeat. Respect the passive and charge from as far as possible: the longer the charge, the more speed AND the more passive damage stacked. Lancer's Last Stand TRICK: if you spawn with it, swap away and swap back; if you just lost a unit, take this one out from supply (best to have it out, swap to another unit, then swap back) -- the 40%-at-60%-headcount doctrine then applies to 100% of the unit. No separate "Example Build" section given beyond the doctrine list. CONFLICT LOGGED: this doctrine block and Tips & Tricks text are near-identical to Amya's Dagger-Axe Lancers guide (the guide's own text flags this) -- see provenance.conflicts, flagged for vet review, recorded as-is per source.
